## TemplateEngine.compileBlockGVenue() method

Compiles venue blocks from a template into executable functions.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static compileBlockGVenue(template: string, baseBlocks?: ReturnType<typeof TemplateEngine._processGBaseBlocks>): {
        [AGBaseId: string]: {
            [ALang: string]: (data?: ITTemplateData) => ITVenueBlock;
        };
    };
```

**Returns:**

{ \[AGBaseId: string\]: { \[ALang: string\]: (data?: ITTemplateData) =&gt; [ITVenueBlock](./gramstax.itvenueblock.md)<!-- -->; }; }

Compiled venue functions organized by base ID and language

## Remarks

Parses `<g-venue>` blocks per base and compiles all four fields (`title`<!-- -->, `address`<!-- -->, `latitude`<!-- -->, `longitude`<!-- -->) through the same pipeline as media captions (script → map → switch → exec → variables), so `{{var|filter}}` works in every field.

## Example


```typescript
const venues = TemplateEngine.compileBlockGVenue(`<g-base><g-venue title="{{name}}" address="Jl. Merdeka 1" latitude="-6.2" longitude="106.8"/></g-base>`);
const result = venues.default?.default?.({ name: 'Cafe' });
// Result: { title: 'Cafe', address: 'Jl. Merdeka 1', latitude: '-6.2', longitude: '106.8' }
```
